rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user using full name and ZIP and acted only on the user’s orders. However, it performed two order-changing writes without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation: (1) it updated the shipping address on the pending watch order to the New York address without asking for confirmation, and (2) it modified one watch from silicone to metal (white) without confirmation. The air purifier change was handled properly with confirmation after recognizing the order was still pending. Because the policy requires explicit confirmation before any order-changing write, these unconfirmed writes cause the interaction to fail the pass bar.
